{{Quote|I concur with the honorable delegate of the Banking Clan. A new conscripted military is what this galaxy needs. One comprised of the people, who fight for the people.|The Commerce Guild senator|<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" />}}
A [[Gossam]] was the '''senator''' of the [[Commerce Guild]] in the [[Imperial Senate]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Proclamation of the New Order|successor]] state of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The senator first appeared in both "[[The Clone Conspiracy]]"<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" /> and "[[Truth and Consequences]],"<ref name="Truth Consequences">{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}}</ref> the seventh and eighth episodes of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' television series' [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]], which both aired on [[February 8]], [[2023]].<ref name="BB S2">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref> The senator was credited as "Senator Gossam" in a caption of a since deleted asset released on Getty Images by [[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Studios]].<ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess|text=The Walt Disney Studios All Access|oldversion=20230405062518|nolive=1}}</ref>
